recommendation: Retain SoilGrids as a global baseline; qualify and register the existing mean-only Icechunk store. Consider uncertainty layers as a distinct useful publication scope. Evaluate alternatives per property/depth/region, without claiming universal scientific supersession.

existing_publication.format: Icechunk repository containing sharded Zarr v3 arrays
existing_publication.native_crs: Interrupted Goode Homolosine, no EPSG code
existing_publication.size: Publisher reports ~177 GB native plus ~90 GB overviews, not newly measured transfer bytes.
existing_publication.quality_status: Publisher documents reversible scaling/source-tile checks. No independent raster comparison or reader test executed in this review.
existing_publication.access_status: Product page and metadata documentation readable through web tool. Direct GET of data.source.coop README returned HTTP403; retained receipt. Full store accessibility remains unqualified.
existing_publication.reader_note: Icechunk-aware reader required; not a generic xr.open_zarr(URL) root. Verify Folia/Portolan access and pin immutable tag or snapshot.
existing_publication.overview_note: Publisher describes chained means for display. Overviews are not uncertainty maps or exact substitutes for independently aggregated source products.

new_publication_candidates.scope: Original SoilGrids Q0.05/Q0.50/Q0.95 at native depths, starting with one property such as SOC
new_publication_candidates.basis: Explicitly omitted by this Source Cooperative publication; producer documents these statistics.
new_publication_candidates.priority: Higher incremental value than another copy of existing means.
new_publication_candidates.limits: No claim that these are absent from every other host. Pin source runs/grid/units and check existing distribution before building.

new_publication_candidates.basis: Documented by current ISRIC layer page; not among the published store's ten depth properties.
new_publication_candidates.priority: Potential additional gap requiring source qualification.
new_publication_candidates.limits: Actual source files/versions were not located or inventoried here; do not treat as ready to build.

new_publication_candidates.basis: Explicitly excluded from the Source Cooperative publication.
new_publication_candidates.limits: ISRIC says these reuse/aggregate 2017 predictions; they are not newly trained v2 class maps. Different grid and identity from v2 numeric properties.

alternatives.name: OpenLandMap-soildb (2026 paper)
alternatives.extent: Global prediction domain excluding deserts/permanent ice per producer README
alternatives.resolution: 30 m means; numeric-property uncertainty products at 120 m
alternatives.time_scope: Carbon/pH use period-specific predictions around 2000–2022; other variables need asset-level checking. Not every property has a dynamic series.
alternatives.properties: SOC content/density, bulk density, pH, sand/silt/clay, plus separate soil-type products. Not the full SoilGrids variable set.
alternatives.uncertainty: P16/P84 nominal 68% intervals, different from SoilGrids P05/P95 nominal 90%. Calibration and accuracy need independent matched validation.
alternatives.format: Producer-built COGs listed on OpenGeoHub S3; GEE and limited Zenodo distributions also exist.
caveats: New release differs from legacy 250 m OpenLandMap GEE products.
Index lists URLs; no object existence, COG compliance or pixel values verified.
Zenodo scope is a 120 m first/last-period subset; do not infer it contains the entire 30 m release.
Finer grid or author-reported internal metrics do not establish superiority to SoilGrids.

alternatives.name: Harmonized World Soil Database v2.01
alternatives.purpose: Harmonized soil mapping units/classification and attributes assembled from national/regional inventories.
alternatives.format: Raster linked to attribute database (.mdb); a useful potential COG plus Parquet mapping representation.
caveats: Coarser and different mapping-unit semantics; not automatically a more accurate pixel prediction.
Retain component proportions and one-to-many attributes when converting.
Redistribution terms/current exact artifacts not qualified here.

alternatives.name: iSDAsoil
alternatives.purpose: 20+ soil properties, including agricultural nutrient variables, plus model-error products.
alternatives.format: Already COG on public AWS with STAC; no account required for listed open bucket.
alternatives.uncertainty: Most products include mean and model error expressed as one standard deviation; transformations are property-specific.
caveats: Regional alternative, not a global replacement.
Finer nominal resolution does not establish better accuracy at every site.

validation_plan: Compare matching property, units, depth support, masks, dates and grid support. Use independent samples not used to train either model; separate regions before evaluation and assess both prediction error and interval coverage. No such experiment ran here.
scope_limits: Documentation and small metadata indexes only; no data bodies, GEE/cloud jobs, private storage, publication or registry changes.
